name: Should I choose a walk-in shower, walk-in tub, or tub-to-shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a walk-in shower, walk-in tub, or tub-to-shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in showers are usually the most practical comparison point against tub-to-shower conversions and walk-in tubs. A walk-in shower is often best for wheelchair or walker access, while a walk-in tub may work better for someone who prefers soaking and can still transfer safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose based on mobility and bathing preferences: walk-in showers are usually best for access, while walk-in tubs fit people who still want soaking and can transfer safely.
